case_number: REVIEW PETITION (CRL.) NO. OF 2022 (Diary No.9265 of 2022) IN SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) NO.4714 OF 2019
summary: The petitioner challenged the concurrent conviction and sentence by the Sessions Court and High Court for offences under Section 302 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code. The Special Leave Petition was dismissed for lack of grounds to interfere. The Review Petition, filed with delay condoned, was dismissed as no error apparent on record was established.
